messages.action_nearby: What's flying nearby? Speak the nearest aircraft
messages.action_listen_atc: Listen to air traffic control (opens LiveATC in your browser)
messages.no_location: No flight radar location is set. Choose your city in Preferences, Flight Radar.
messages.err_offline: Could not reach the flight data service. Check your internet connection.
messages.err_service: The flight data service is not responding properly. Please try again later.
messages.err_rate_limited: The flight data service asked Hariku to slow down. Please try again in a minute.
messages.err_bad_response: The flight data service sent data Hariku could not read. Please try again later.
messages.none_in_air: No aircraft in the air within {radius} right now.
messages.squawk_2000: no code assigned yet (usually when entering controlled airspace)
messages.squawk_7000: visual flight, no code assigned (used in many countries)
messages.squawk_1200: visual flight, no code assigned (used in the US and Canada)
messages.squawk_other: a code assigned by air traffic control to identify this flight
messages.atc_opening_feed: Opening LiveATC for {airport} in your browser.
messages.atc_opening_search: Opening LiveATC's page for {airport} in your browser. It shows whether a live feed exists.
messages.atc_whole_frequency: You'll hear the whole frequency, not just this aircraft.
messages.atc_no_airport: Hariku does not know an airport near here to listen to.
messages.list_no_data: No radar data yet. Press Refresh to try again.
messages.lbl_search: City to search for (press Enter to search):
messages.lbl_results_count: City search results, {count} found. Select your city, then press OK:
messages.search_too_short: Type at least 2 letters of the city name.
messages.search_found_one: 1 place found. Select it in the search results, then press OK.
messages.search_found: {count} places found. Select your city in the search results, then press OK.
messages.err_search: Could not search for cities. Check your internet connection and try again.
messages.lbl_address: Street address to search for (press Enter to search):
messages.lbl_addresses_count: Address search results, {count} found. Select yours, then press OK:
messages.address_too_short: Type at least 3 letters of the address.
messages.address_found: {count} addresses found. Select yours in the address results, then press OK.
messages.err_address_search: Could not search for addresses. Check your internet connection and try again.
messages.err_address_busy: The address search is busy. Please wait a minute and try again.
messages.lbl_coordinates: Coordinates or map link (press Enter to use):
messages.coords_found: Location found: {place}, {hint}. Press OK to save it.
messages.coords_empty: Paste coordinates or a map link first.
messages.coords_not_found: Hariku could not find coordinates in that text. Paste coordinates such as -6.2088, 106.8456, or a map link.
messages.coords_out_of_range: Those coordinates are out of range. Put the latitude first, between -90 and 90, then the longitude, between -180 and 180.
messages.coords_zero: 0, 0 is not a real place. Check the coordinates and try again.
messages.link_expanding: Opening the short link to find its coordinates...
messages.link_no_coordinates: That map link does not contain coordinates. In your map app, drop a pin on the place, copy its coordinates, and paste them here instead.
messages.link_failed: Could not open that short link. Check your internet connection, or paste the coordinates instead.
messages.privacy_note: Your exact location is kept only on this computer; the flight data services receive it rounded to about 1 kilometre. An address search sends the address you type to OpenStreetMap.
messages.chk_emergency_watch: Watch for emergencies in the background
messages.alerts_note: While Hariku is running, overhead alerts check for aircraft about every 30 seconds and the emergency watch about every 60 seconds.
messages.atc_note: Listen to ATC opens LiveATC's website in your browser; Hariku never plays the radio itself. Rules on listening to aviation radio differ by country.
messages.attribution_routes: Flight routes: adsbdb.com (route data by David Taylor and Jim Mason)
